instruction.text: Write in the gap to complete the idiom.

atoms.b: Great, we are on the same ((page)).

wrong.text: to be on the same page: two or more people have the same opinion on something
wrong.sound: To be on the same page means that two or more people have the same opinion on something

atoms.b: This happens once in a ((blue)) moon.

wrong.text: once in a blue moon: something happens very rarely
wrong.sound: Once in a blue moon means that something happens very rarely.

atoms.b: Wow! You always go the ((extra)) mile.

wrong.text: to go the extra mile: to make a special effort
wrong.sound: To go the extra mile means to make a special effort

atoms.b: It's alright. A leopard can’t change its ((spots)).

wrong.text: a leopard can’t change its spots: one cannot change the way one is
wrong.sound: A leopard can’t change its spots means one cannot change the way one is.

atoms.b: It's a ((piece)) of cake to solve this problem.

wrong.text: a piece of cake: a thing that is very easy to do
wrong.sound: A piece of cake means a thing that is very easy to do.

atoms.b: Hopefully you put your ((money)) where your mouth is!

wrong.text: to put your money where your mouth is!: to support what you say by actually doing it
wrong.sound: To put your money where your mouth is means to support what you say by actually doing it.

atoms.b: I am sure you will do your best. ((Break)) a leg!

wrong.sound: break a leg means wishing someone good luck.

wrong.text: to jump the gun: to start doing something too soon
wrong.sound: To jump the gun means to start doing something too soon.

atoms.b: This time, I go the whole nine ((yards)) with the decoration.

wrong.text: the whole nine yards: something which includes everything
wrong.sound: the whole nine yards means something which includes everything.

atoms.b: It's a bad situation, but I have to ((bite)) the bullet.

wrong.text: to bite the bullet: to do or accept something unpleasant
wrong.sound: to bite the bullet means to do or accept something unpleasant.

atoms.b: We met in a cafe to ((chew)) the fat for a while.

wrong.text: to chew the fat: to have a long, informal talk with someone
wrong.sound: to chew the fat means to have a long, informal talk with someone.

wrong.text: to play it by ear: to improvise
wrong.sound: to play it by ear; means to improvise.

atoms.b: Oh, that is not my ((cup)) of tea.

wrong.text: not my cup of tea: not what somebody likes
wrong.sound: not my cup of tea means it's not what somebody likes.

atoms.b: Let's get the ((show)) on the road!

wrong.text: to get the show on the road: to start something
wrong.sound: to get the show on the road means to start something.

atoms.b: He always feels exhausted when he burns the ((midnight)) oil.

wrong.text: to burn the midnight oil: to stay up working
wrong.sound: to burn the midnight oil means to stay up working.
